warnings: 3 market oracle implementations have no feed composition in the indexer.
model.scope: One Morpho V1-family vault and its direct lending markets, borrowers, oracle contracts and indexer-known feed/conversion-vault inputs. Conversion vault internals, feed implementation internals, custodians and token issuers are not recursively verified.

liquidity.label: Queue-based capacity estimate, assuming withdrawals succeed and no earlier users consume the cash; not a transaction simulation.

result.decision: Supply an event probability and total exit cost to compare staying with withdrawing.

recognition.note: Proportional economic exposure is not a promised redemption price. Vault loss-recognition implementation and withdrawal order are unverified.

assumptions: Instant collateral shock followed by eventual recovery at the declared discount; no liquidation timing, slippage curve or borrower top-up simulation.
Recovery discount also applies to unaffected markets when assessing their existing collateral coverage.
Oracle response is a scenario assumption, not a finding about feed behaviour.
Loss bounds cover missing collateral marks and borrower debt only; they are not confidence intervals or bounds on every possible failure.
The position size is hypothetical exposure to a real vault, not a verified wallet or a Belem holding.

reverse.label: Collateral decline reaching the limit with the same recovery assumption. A zero possible boundary can result from missing valuations; it is not a prediction.
